name: Modified Straight-Through Estimator (mSTE)
definition: A variant of STE that rescales the detached codec error using the standard deviation of the quantization error to modulate the backward signal.
summary: mSTE is a gradient extension technique for differentiable volume rendering that rescales detached codec-induced perturbations by their standard deviation to provide more informative gradients than vanilla STE in high-bitrate regimes.
